user_history.review_text: I have been sprouting for several years and tried multiple systems. I do prefer those with zero waste, so I like the compostable mats. The brochure in the box claims to have 12 mats in this set, but I only had 6, and they're a buck each to replace, so I won't be buying their refills. You can get big jute mats to cut to size, or micro mats in 4x4 to use at a fraction of that here on Amazon. I've used Hamama sprouting systems in the past and loved the convenience of the pre-seeded mats, but also very expensive and the tray is large, so you have to eat all the sprouts within a day or two. With these small trays, you can start the seeds on different days so you can keep a steady fresh harvest ready a little each day. I've also used mason jars and the plus with those is zero waste, but also you get clumps of greens instead of neat rows. Good for sandwiches and salads, but not if you like pretty neat rows of microgreens atop your food as a garnish.  The seeds are a nice quality, and the containers are sturdy and durable.
